stemMd: Why was the shortcut absent from the official map?

options.label: A
options.textMd: It had not been designated a public path.

options.label: B
options.textMd: The bus stop did not exist.

options.label: C
options.textMd: No resident had ever used it.

options.label: D
options.textMd: The planners had already paved it.

options.label: E
options.textMd: It was longer than the formal route.

explanationMd: The passage gives a classification reason: the route was informal rather than officially designated. This explains its absence without implying that it was unused or physically nonexistent.

distractorRationale.b: The bus stop is the destination of the route.
distractorRationale.d: The field route was muddy after rain.
